ErrorCode.description:
**ErrorCode Enum:**

| ErrorCode | Description |
|------|------|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is not valid considering the documented schema. |
| `CONTENT_TOO_LARGE` | The request is too large. Consider splitting it into multiple requests. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is not authorized to make the given request. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The requested resource does not exist. |
| `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` | There have been too many requests, please slow down your call rate. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | The request lacks the necessary credentials. |

ManagerAccountDspGrouping.description:
**ManagerAccountDspGrouping Enum:**

| ManagerAccountDspGrouping | Description |
|------|------|
| `DSP_ADVERTISER_ACCOUNT` | Prefer one row per DSP advertiser account. DSP advertiser accounts upgraded to a global advertiser account may already appear as a single row regardless of this setting. This field will be deprecated after 03/2027. |
| `GLOBAL_ADVERTISER_ACCOUNT` | Prefer DSP advertiser accounts grouped into a single row per advertiser account. Only applies to DSP advertiser accounts that have been upgraded to a global advertiser account. |

ReportFormat.description:
**ReportFormat Enum:**

| ReportFormat | Description |
|------|------|
| `CSV` | Comma-separated values file containing plain text tabular data |
| `GZIP_JSON` | JSON file compressed using GZIP format |
| `PARTITIONED_CSV` | Contents split into multiple CSV files |
| `PARTITIONED_GZIP_JSON` | Contents split into multiple GZIP-compressed JSON files |

ReportPart.description: A downloadable part of the generated report

sizeInBytes.description: Size of the part file in bytes, could reach up to 100GB

urlExpirationDateTime.description: Expiration date and time when the above URL expires

ReportWarning.description: Explains a limitation affecting a field's values in the report, such as redacted values or reduced coverage. A field may carry more than one reason.

field.description: The field this warning applies to. E.g. metric.userReach

warningCodes.description: Reasons a limitation applies to the field's values

ReportWarningCode.description:
**ReportWarningCode Enum:**

| ReportWarningCode | Description |
|------|------|
| `DATE_LIMITED` | The field has no data for part of the requested period |
| `NO_PERMISSION` | One or more accounts in the report's scope do not have access to the field |
| `PENDING_DEPRECATION` | The field is pending deprecation |

info.description:
Amazon Ads API v1 is a reimagined approach to our Ads API, built to provide a seamless experience across all Amazon advertising products through a common model. [Learn more about Ads API v1.](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference/amazon-ads/overview) To learn about prerequisites and header values, see [Getting started with Amazon Ads API v1](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference/amazon-ads/getting-started).

**Download Amazon Ads API V1 OpenAPI Spec** ([All Products](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPIALLMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SP](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISPMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SP Global](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISPGLOBALMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SB](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISBMerged_prod_3p.json) | [DSP](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPIDSPMerged_prod_3p.json) | [ST](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISTMerged_prod_3p.json) | [SD](https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/AmazonAdsAPISDMerged_prod_3p.json))
